title: Better Drawing
features:
What is Better-Drawing?

Better-Drawing is a custom wrapper for Roblox's Drawing API that makes it way easier to work with visuals like ESPs, boxes, text, and more.

The main benefit is that it automatically handles cleanup so you don’t have to manually remove elements or clear them every frame. Once you're done using a drawing (like when a player disappears), it gets deleted automatically. That means cleaner code and fewer performance issues.
